intro: Open Water Sparkling at CAVA offers a refreshing, zero-calorie beverage option made from purified sparkling water. This clean and simple drink provides the perfect palate cleanser for your Mediterranean meal. Available on the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks), it complements any selection from the [full CAVA menu](/). Priced between $2.95 and $3.25, this carbonated water delivers crisp refreshment without added sugars, sweeteners, or artificial ingredients.
priceCalories: Open Water Sparkling is priced at $2.95 to $3.25 depending on location and size. With 0 calories, 0g protein, 0g carbs, and 0g fat, this beverage fits seamlessly into any dietary plan. It provides guilt-free hydration that will not impact your daily calorie goals, making it an ideal choice for health-conscious diners exploring the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator).
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Open Water Sparkling apart is its commitment to purity and sustainability. Made with only purified sparkling water and nothing else, this drink lets you enjoy effervescent refreshment without compromising your health goals. The clean ingredient list makes it suitable for virtually every dietary preference, from keto to vegan. It is the perfect complement to the bold Mediterranean flavors found throughout CAVA offerings.
nutritionFacts: Open Water Sparkling contains 0 calories, 0g protein, 0g carbohydrates, and 0g fat per serving. With no sodium, sugar, or artificial additives, this beverage offers pure hydration with a satisfying fizz. The simple nutritional profile makes it compatible with low-carb, keto, paleo, vegan, and gluten-free diets. Check the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for complete dietary information across all menu items.
whatsInside: Open Water Sparkling contains just one ingredient: purified sparkling water. This minimalist approach ensures you receive clean, crisp carbonation without any hidden additives, preservatives, or sweeteners. The purification process removes impurities while maintaining refreshing taste. This transparency in ingredients aligns with CAVA commitment to quality and wholesome menu options that customers can trust and enjoy with complete confidence.
tasteLike: Open Water Sparkling delivers a clean, crisp taste with lively carbonation that refreshes your palate. The effervescent bubbles provide a satisfying texture without any sweetness or flavor additives. It tastes like pure, high-quality sparkling water should—refreshing and neutral. This makes it perfect for cleansing your palate between bites of flavorful items from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) and [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings).
customize: Open Water Sparkling comes as a standalone beverage and does not require customization. However, you can enhance your dining experience by pairing it with different menu combinations. Some guests enjoy adding a squeeze of fresh lemon if available. The neutral profile means it will not compete with the flavors of your customized bowl or pita, allowing the Mediterranean ingredients to shine through your entire meal.
pairsWell: Open Water Sparkling pairs excellently with virtually any item from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) or [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas). The carbonation helps cut through rich dips like hummus and tzatziki, while refreshing your palate between bites. It complements spicy harissa or bold falafel especially well. Consider it alongside grilled proteins from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) for a balanced, health-focused meal.
healthyChoice: Open Water Sparkling is an exceptionally healthy beverage choice with zero calories, sugar, or artificial ingredients. It provides hydration with the added satisfaction of carbonation, making it easier to stay hydrated throughout your day. The absence of sweeteners means no blood sugar spikes or empty calories. For those monitoring nutritional intake, this drink supports weight management and clean eating goals without sacrificing refreshment or enjoyment.
howToOrder: To order Open Water Sparkling, simply add it to your meal when selecting beverages at the counter or through the CAVA app. It is available at all [CAVA Locations](/locations) as part of the drinks selection. Request it by name when building your bowl or pita, or add it to your order at checkout. The straightforward ordering process makes it easy to include this refreshing beverage with any meal combination.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Classic Lemonade at 260-360 calories or Blueberry Lavender at 140-190 calories, Open Water Sparkling offers zero-calorie refreshment. While flavored drinks provide sweetness, Open Water delivers pure hydration without sugar or calories. It costs slightly less at $2.95-$3.25 versus $3.45-$3.85 for flavored options. Choose Open Water when you want crisp refreshment that will not add to your daily calorie count.
whoShouldTry: Open Water Sparkling is perfect for health-conscious diners, athletes, and anyone monitoring calorie intake. Those following keto, paleo, or low-carb diets will appreciate the zero-carb profile. It suits guests who prefer unsweetened beverages or want to avoid artificial sweeteners. Anyone seeking pure hydration with carbonation should choose this option. It is also ideal for cleansing your palate when enjoying complex Mediterranean flavors.
worthTrying: Open Water Sparkling is absolutely worth trying if you value clean ingredients and zero-calorie refreshment. At under $3.25, it provides premium sparkling water that enhances your dining experience without compromising health goals. The simple purity allows CAVA bold Mediterranean flavors to take center stage. For guilt-free hydration that supports any dietary plan, Open Water Sparkling delivers exceptional value and refreshment with every effervescent sip.
